Class SignupService

java.lang.Object
com.cab302.vic.service.SignupService
public class SignupService extends Object
Business rules for volunteers signing up to events and coordinators recording who attended.

The rules:

  • A volunteer can sign up for an event today or later, once, while there are spots left.
  • They can withdraw until the event has happened, unless their attendance has already been recorded.
  • Only the coordinator who created an event can record attendance, and only on or after the day of the event.

"Today" comes from a Clock so tests can fix the date instead of depending on when they run.
